name: Kurashiru, Inc.
summary: Kurashiru, Inc. engages in the platform business in Japan, Singapore, and internationally. It offers advertising services, including Kurashiru, a recipe video platform; Receipt Challenge by Kurashiru, a smart savings app; Kurashiru AI OS, an AI agent platform for CPG brands, wholesalers, and retailers; TRILL, a lifestyle information media; and LIVEwith, a creator management agency. The company was formerly known as dely Inc. and changed its name to Kurashiru, Inc. in October 2025. Kurashiru, Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.
